title: feat: add sharktide to GitHub Polli whitelist
author: Itachi-1824
pr_body_excerpt:
- Expands GitHub Polli access from 7 to 8 authorized users across both workflows.
- Adds sharktide using immutable GitHub user ID 189873015.
- Enables access to the !polli assistant for issue and PR review/coding requests, plus automated fixes for issues labeled POLLI.

gist.headline: One more bee in the hive
gist.blurb: sharktide has been added to Polli’s GitHub guest list. The tiny assistant now recognizes one more trusted human when issues and PRs need tending.
gist.summary: Added GitHub user ID 189873015 (sharktide) to the authorization allowlists in both the !polli assistant and POLLI-labeled issue auto-fix workflows, expanding access from seven to eight users.
gist.impact: sharktide can now invoke !polli for issue and PR review or coding requests, and use the automated fix flow for issues labeled POLLI.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a cozy beekeeper at a small GitHub-themed garden gate, adding an eighth named badge to a trusted visitor board while a CRT monitor robot happily stamps an access card. Include code-plants and a subtle issue/PR terminal to represent assistant and auto-fix workflow access.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny beekeeper hat, adding an eighth visitor badge labeled “sharktide” to a garden gate beside a glowing GitHub-style terminal; a cheerful CRT monitor robot holds an access card while code-plants bloom nearby. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with subtle pixel text: “ACCESS GRANTED”.
